source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Set console through SOL (ttyS0)

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. SOL (ttyS0) should be set successfully.
2. Terminal should have correct output when connecting via SOL.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- COM 0 -> SOL: set Linux console through SOL (ttyS0). Agent verifies the current console/kernel cmdline sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "cat /proc/cmdline 2>&1; grep -E 'console' /etc/default/grub 2>&1"; setting/confirming the SOL (ttyS0) console output needs terminal access at the SOL (ttyS0) side.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the kernel cmdline + grub console settings so the user confirms console=SOL (ttyS0) is configured; the actual terminal output over SOL (ttyS0) is observed by the operator.

original_test_intent: Route Linux console ttyS0 to the mapped BMC SOL channel and prove a bounded remote session receives correct readable output.
original_method: Apply approved console configuration, reboot if required, open SOL and capture console output.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies/approves mapping, boot diff and reboot; the software configuration, bounded SOL activation, transcript capture and checks can be automated.
required_inputs: Session ownership, timeout and alternate recovery
safety_requirements: Do not interrupt an owned SOL/debug session.
Protect credentials and preserve boot config.
Bound and terminate the session cleanly; no arbitrary console input.
No automatic retry; use alternate recovery if boot access is lost.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, apply exact diff, reboot once if planned, activate bounded SOL, capture/redact output, verify readability and restore config/session.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Configuration reads are incomplete, but no inherent human-only action prevents a PTY-capable agent from bounded SOL capture.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use project-approved boot config and SOL client with secure secrets, explicit timeout and clean escape/termination.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ttyS0 over SOL, readable output, script and 10/0 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot config, apply reviewed ttyS0/SOL settings, perform one approved reboot, capture firmware/boot/OS output in a bounded session, terminate and restore.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SOL and OS serial-console documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic session control, secure credentials and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves actual SOL output, not just config text.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad console config can remove remote visibility.

project_override_considerations: Alternate approved SOL client is acceptable if it exercises the same mapped channel and output stages.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently targets SOL ttyS0; missing mapping/settings are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: With a PTY-capable runner and approved inputs, all core software actions/evidence are automatable; approval does not make it PARTIAL.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Reclassifies PACKAGE to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under locked V3.1 capability rules.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates engineer verdict and adds bounded session controls.

review_improvement: Proves actual SOL characters with reversible boot configuration and deterministic cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: SOL is a network terminal stream; a controlled PTY can open, read, timestamp and terminate it programmatically, so human observation is not inherently required once identity and policy are approved.
